contract.visual: Every accepted sound has a visual twin: the 149 indicator (one bounded status line) and, for the learning and the publication, the real 079 notification rows.

scenarios.name: gesture-required
scenarios.detail: Without a player gesture the engine refuses the cue; the visual twin of the takeover is still shown.

scenarios.name: takeover
scenarios.detail: The real 007 MANUAL_START event becomes one takeover cue; the relayed and the direct repetition sound nothing.

scenarios.name: publication
scenarios.detail: The 007 PROFILE_ACTIVATE event and the 079 publication notification share one key: the profile sounds once.

scenarios.name: late-result
scenarios.detail: A validated candidate is an analysis result, not a publication; the late publication sounds its own real outcome.

scenarios.name: rapid-toggle
scenarios.detail: Sixty mute and category toggles and a burst of ten takeovers never create a second voice nor an orphan one.

scenarios.name: mission-state
scenarios.detail: The mission state is read from the real 116 tracker: one sound per real state, nothing for an unknown instance.

scenarios.name: visual-equivalent
scenarios.detail: The indicator mirrors the last sound and the 079 infrastructure keeps the detailed publication row.
